fig_5_1_dfd0.title: Fig 5.1 DFD Level 0
fig_5_1_dfd0.caption: Fig 5.1 DFD Level 0 (Context Diagram)
fig_5_1_dfd0.description: The DFD Level 0 diagram, also known as the context diagram, represents the overall functioning of the AgroDrone system as a single central process. It shows how primary external entities such as the Farmer/Operator, Agronomist/Admin, and Drone Hardware interact with the system boundary and the database.
fig_5_1_dfd0.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Farmer["👨‍🌾 Farmer / Operator"] -->|"Flight Plan & Grid Parameters"| P0(["0.0 AgroDrone Core System"])
    P0 -->|"Real-time Telemetry & Crop Health Alerts"| Farmer
    Admin["👤 Agronomist / Admin"] -->|"Disease Detection Models & Config"| P0
    P0 -->|"Field Analytics & Chemical Savings Reports"| Admin
    DroneHW["🚁 AgroDrone Hardware Sensors/Actuators"] -->|"RGB/NIR Frames & GPS Coordinates"| P0
    P0 -->|"ESP32 Pump Relay Spray Commands"| DroneHW
    P0 <-->|"Flight Logs & Telemetry Data"| DB[("Central AgroDB Data Store")]

fig_5_2_dfd1.title: Fig 5.2 DFD Level 1
fig_5_2_dfd1.caption: Fig 5.2 DFD Level 1
fig_5_2_dfd1.description: The DFD Level 1 diagram expands the AgroDrone system into four core functional processes. It illustrates how data flows between external entities, primary processing modules (Navigation, Analytics, Spraying, and Reporting), and persistent data stores D1, D2, and D3.
fig_5_2_dfd1.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Farmer["👨‍🌾 Farmer / Operator"] -->|"Mission Waypoints"| P1(["1.0 Navigation & Flight Telemetry Module"])
    P1 -->|"Pixhawk Waypoint Navigation"| DroneHW["🚁 Drone Hardware"]
    DroneHW -->|"RGB & NIR Video Stream + GPS"| P2(["2.0 Multi-Spectral Edge Processing"])
    P1 <-->|"Read / Store Flight Path Logs"| D1[("D1 Flight Waypoints & GPS Logs")]
    D2[("D2 YOLO Models & NDVI Thresholds")] -->|"Model Weights & Criteria"| P2
    P2 -->|"Infected Spot Coordinates & Stress Index"| P3(["3.0 Precision Spot Spray Control"])
    P2 -->|"Write Crop Health Data"| D3[("D3 Crop Health & Spray Logs")]
    P3 -->|"ESP32 PWM Trigger Signal"| DroneHW
    P3 -->|"Log Spray Volume & Duration"| D3
    D3 -->|"Read Field Analytics Data"| P4(["4.0 Field Health Analytics & Report Generation"])
    P4 -->|"NDVI Heatmaps & Chemical Savings Summary"| Agronomist["👤 Agronomist / Admin"]
    P4 -->|"Field Dashboard Alerts"| Farmer

fig_5_3_dfd2.title: Fig 5.3 DFD Level 2
fig_5_3_dfd2.caption: Fig 5.3 DFD Level 2
fig_5_3_dfd2.description: The DFD Level 2 diagram provides a detailed decomposition of the sub-processes within image analytics and spray execution. It demonstrates frame preprocessing, NDVI computation, YOLOv8 disease classification, target localization, and ESP32 relay actuation.
fig_5_3_dfd2.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    DroneHW["🚁 Drone Camera & GPS"] -->|"Raw Multispectral Imagery Stream"| P2_1(["2.1 Frame Alignment & RGB/NIR Separation"])
    P2_1 -->|"NIR + RED Aligned Channel Data"| P2_2(["2.2 NDVI Index Computation Engine"])
    P2_1 -->|"Aligned Leaf RGB Frames"| P2_3(["2.3 YOLOv8-Nano Disease Classifier"])
    D2[("D2 YOLO Model & NDVI Thresholds")] -->|"NDVI Threshold (NDVI < 0.3)"| P2_2
    D2 -->|"Blight / Rust Detection Weights"| P2_3
    P2_2 -->|"Water Stress Flag + Spatial Target"| P3_1(["3.1 Target Spatial Localization Engine"])
    P2_3 -->|"Leaf Disease Bounding Box + GPS Spot"| P3_1
    P3_1 -->|"Validated Spot Target Coordinates"| P3_2(["3.2 ESP32 Relay Micro-Spray Controller"])
    P3_2 -->|"1.5s PWM Spray Pulse"| Pump["💧 12V Diaphragm Spray Pump"]
    P3_2 -->|"Log Spray Spot, Timestamp & Volume"| D3[("D3 Crop Health & Spray Logs")]

fig_5_4_block_diagram.title: Fig 5.4 Block Diagram
fig_5_4_block_diagram.caption: Fig 5.4 Block Diagram (Complete System Block Architecture)
fig_5_4_block_diagram.description: The block diagram details the complete multi-tier architecture of the AgroDrone solution, spanning user inputs, hardware sensors, edge processing components on the Raspberry Pi 4, spatial decision execution, database stores, and user analytics outputs.
fig_5_4_block_diagram.mermaid:
graph TB
    subgraph USERS["👤 USER INTERFACE TIER"]
        Farmer["👨‍🌾 Farmer / Drone Operator"]
        Agronomist["👤 Field Agronomist / Admin"]
    end

    subgraph INPUT["📡 HARDWARE SENSOR & TELEMETRY STREAM"]
        Cam["Multi-Spectral Camera (RGB + NIR)"]
        GPS["Pixhawk 4 GPS & Telemetry Module"]
        Mission["Mission Planner Flight Waypoint File"]
    end

    subgraph PROCESSING["⚙️ RASPBERRY PI 4 EDGE PROCESSING PIPELINE"]
        Step1["1. Frame Channel Dewarping & Alignment"]
        Step2["2. NDVI Computation Engine (NIR-RED)/(NIR+RED)"]
        Step3["3. Edge-optimized YOLOv8-Nano Leaf Blight Detector"]
        Step4["4. Spatial Target Matching & Coordinate Mapper"]
        Step5["5. ESP32 Spray Relay Command Controller"]
    end

    subgraph STORAGE["💾 DATA STORAGE & PERSISTENCE LAYER"]
        DB1[("D1 Flight Path & GPS Logs")]
        DB2[("D2 Disease Models & NDVI Rules")]
        DB3[("D3 Field Health Analytics & Spray Logs")]
    end

    subgraph OUTPUT["🚀 ACTUATOR & OUTPUT DASHBOARD TIER"]
        Pump["💧 12V Diaphragm Pump & PWM Misting Nozzles"]
        Dashboard["🌐 Flask Telemetry Dashboard & NDVI Heatmap"]
        Report["📊 CSV Chemical Savings & Crop Health Summary"]
    end

    Mission --> Step1
    Cam --> Step1
    GPS --> Step4
    Step1 --> Step2
    Step1 --> Step3
    DB2 --> Step2
    DB2 --> Step3
    Step2 --> Step4
    Step3 --> Step4
    Step4 --> Step5
    Step5 --> Pump
    Step1 --> DB1
    Step4 --> DB3
    DB3 --> Dashboard
    DB3 --> Report
    Farmer --> Mission
    Dashboard --> Farmer
    Report --> Agronomist

fig_5_5_activity_diagram.title: Fig 5.5 Activity Diagram
fig_5_5_activity_diagram.caption: Fig 5.5 Activity Diagram (System Workflow)
fig_5_5_activity_diagram.description: The activity diagram illustrates the operational workflow of the AgroDrone system, detailing user authentication, role verification, autonomous drone waypoint execution, real-time edge processing, targeted spray decision logic, and post-flight report generation.
fig_5_5_activity_diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Start(["Start System Operation"])
    Login["Authenticate Operator Credentials"]
    CheckAuth{"Valid Login?"}
    RoleCheck{"Check User Role"}

    AdminPath["Manage YOLO Models & NDVI Rule Parameters"]
    ViewReports["View Multi-Field Comparative Reports"]

    UploadGrid["Upload Grid Waypoints (5m Flight Altitude)"]
    LaunchDrone["Launch Autonomous Drone Flight Session"]
    CaptureData["Capture Multi-Spectral RGB/NIR Frames & GPS Telemetry"]
    RunAnalytics["Compute NDVI Index & YOLO Leaf Disease Classification"]

    CheckTarget{"Target Spot: NDVI < 0.3 OR Disease Confirmed?"}
    TriggerRelay["Send 1.5s PWM Signal to ESP32 Spray Pump Relay"]
    LogSpray["Log Spray Spot Coordinates & Chemical Volume Saved"]
    BypassSpray["Continue Grid Route without Spraying"]

    CheckGrid{"Mission Waypoints Completed?"}
    LandDrone["Return to Launch (RTL) & Autonomous Landing"]
    GenReport["Generate Field Health Heatmap & Spray Analytics Summary"]
    End(["End Session"])

    Start --> Login
    Login --> CheckAuth
    CheckAuth -->|"No"| Login
    CheckAuth -->|"Yes"| RoleCheck
    RoleCheck -->|"Admin / Agronomist"| AdminPath
    AdminPath --> ViewReports
    ViewReports --> End
    RoleCheck -->|"Operator / Farmer"| UploadGrid
    UploadGrid --> LaunchDrone
    LaunchDrone --> CaptureData
    CaptureData --> RunAnalytics
    RunAnalytics --> CheckTarget
    CheckTarget -->|"Yes"| TriggerRelay
    TriggerRelay --> LogSpray
    LogSpray --> CheckGrid
    CheckTarget -->|"No"| BypassSpray
    BypassSpray --> CheckGrid
    CheckGrid -->|"No"| CaptureData
    CheckGrid -->|"Yes"| LandDrone
    LandDrone --> GenReport
    GenReport --> End

fig_5_6_use_case.caption: Fig 5.6 Use Case Diagram

    Agronomist["👤 Field Agronomist / Admin"]

        UC2(["UC2: Execute Autonomous Flight Session"])
        UC3(["UC3: Process Multispectral RGB/NIR Stream"])
        UC4(["UC4: Compute NDVI Index & Detect Diseases"])
        UC5(["UC5: Trigger Precision Spot Micro-Spraying"])
        UC6(["UC6: View Real-Time Field Telemetry & Heatmap"])
        UC7(["UC7: Update YOLO Disease Weights & Thresholds"])

    Farmer --> UC1
    Farmer --> UC2
    Farmer --> UC6

    UC2 -.->|"<<include>>"| UC3
    UC3 -.->|"<<include>>"| UC4
    UC4 -.->|"<<conditional>>"| UC5
    UC5 --> Actuator
    Agronomist --> UC6
    Agronomist --> UC7
    Agronomist --> UC8
